Nioh 3 Ninja Kusarigama Build - Fuma Kamaitachi (Beginner Build)
In this Nioh 3 build guide, we're going to be taking a look at how to put together the Fuma Kamaitachi using the Kusarigama weapon for the Ninja style. This build takes advantage of the reach of the Kusarigama, combined with the high mobility of the Ninja style to harass your enemies with strings of attacks. I'll be showing you where to place your stats and skills to get the maximum impact from this build, as wellas what equipment to use and which Guardian Spirit and Soul Cores to have.
This is an early and mid-game build, meant for players to easily put together from the early parts of the game, and has the potential tobe used all the way to the end of the game with slight adjustments and upgrades.
